notes: Consumer-side animation specification for the Reimu slouch (趴桌/伏案) pose family.
This file is NOT a Sprite Harness Animation Plan; tools/build_reimu_animations.py deterministically expands it into one legal plan per state and drives the public sprite-harness CLI.
This set exists so one authored pose family can serve idle_table_slouch, idle_yawn, doze_nod, sleep_table and wake_up, which the action catalog lists as five separate actions built on two bodies.
Every state here is layered: no flattened base sprite is authored for this set, and no layer may be derived from the eating set's flattened sprites.
sleep_table is the planned second slice and is deliberately not declared yet: declaring an unauthored state would widen the allowed-PNG set and weaken the intake gate.
A state with both eye layers present must declare layer_visibility for the 'eyes' group or the build fails closed.

pose_prop is a held slouch loop: nothing translates and the only change is a blink. The eyes group shows eyes_open except on frames 32-33, which the builder expands into opacity keyframe tracks (hold interpolation) targeting the two eye layers, so exactly one is ever composited.

Time-varying visibility needs keyframe tracks and therefore sprite-harness >= 0.8.0; the published 0.7.0 rejects them with MALFORMED_SPEC. Constant visibility needs no tracks at all because a layer hidden for the whole state is left out of the composed source.
The 7 s cycle mirrors the approved standing blink rhythm, but fps, frame_count and the blink frames have NOT been visually approved yet.

expected_validation_warnings is an allow-list: a warning outside it fails the build. It is empty because pose_prop now carries real motion, so a future ZERO_MOTION would be a regression rather than an expected condition.
